references.text: Gives the lineage of Shem from Shem to Abram, elaborating on the description of Shem as 'father of all the children of Eber'.
Noah's blessing of Shem and Japheth, providing context for the relationship between the brothers mentioned in 10:21.
Eber is named as the father of Peleg and Joktan, a direct elaboration on Eber's descendants to whom Shem is the ancestor.
Balaam's prophecy mentions Eber, linking him to Shem as 'father of all the children of Eber'.
The sons and descendants of Japheth, relevant because Shem is described as 'the elder brother of Japheth' in the verse.
10:21 establishes Shem as the ancestor of Eber (forebears of the Messiah), while Luke 3:36 shows this lineage fulfilled in Jesus.
1:17 confirms and expands on 10:21 by listing Shem's sons, including Eber, thereby supporting Shem's role as an ancestor.
11:10 confirms and specifies the claim in 10:21 that Shem is the ancestor of Eber by listing Arpachshad as Shem's son.
26:45 confirms that Eber (mentioned in 10:21 as a descendant of Shem) indeed became the ancestor of a people group (Hebrews).
